definitions.gloss: to go to school; to attend school
definitions.explanation: To go to school for the day's classes, specifically the act of traveling to and arriving at school. Used for regular school attendance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧8⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登校|とうこう}する。
examples.english: I go to school at 8 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧になった。
examples.english: The snow made it difficult to get to school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登校|とうこう}する⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing children cheerfully heading to school brightens my morning.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time to be at school
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧⟦{班|はん}→班：03697_han⟧: neighborhood group of children who walk to school together
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}{日|び}→登校日：20283_toukoubi⟧: a day pupils must come to school, especially one set during the holidays
- ⟦{不登校|ふとうこう}→不登校：11317_futoukou⟧: not attending school, school refusal (the older term is ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登校|とうこう}する is the act of going to school on a given day; ⟦{通学|つうがく}する→通学する：22147_tsuugakusuru⟧ is attending school as a regular commute (⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通学|つうがく}する→通学する：22147_tsuugakusuru⟧).
- The opposite is ⟦{下校|げこう}する→下校する：25401_gekousuru⟧ (leaving school for home), as ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧/⟦{退勤|たいきん}→退勤：04550_taikin⟧ pair for work.
